guide.title: How to Seam Seal a Tent
guide.description: Find the real leak with a hose test, then pick seam sealer, seam tape, or a DWR refresh, and let it cure over the off-season.
guide.metaTitle: How to Seam Seal a Tent and Find Leaks
guide.metaDescription: How to seam seal a tent: find the real leak first, pick seam sealer, seam tape, or a DWR refresh, and do it in the off-season so it cures before spring.
